title: Acyclicity after removing constants
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number, and let $G$ be an acyclic list of gates relative to $n$ inputs. Prefixing the list of three constant-construction gates and then replacing each gate of $G$ by its strict version produces an acyclic gate list relative to the same $n$ inputs.
